# Bitter espresso, answered

## Why does my espresso taste bitter?

Bitter espresso is usually over-extracted: the water pulled too much from the coffee.

## How do I fix a bitter shot?

Grind a little coarser, or stop the shot a few seconds earlier.

### Is my grinder the problem?

An uneven grinder can over-extract part of the puck while under-extracting the rest.

## What temperature should the water be?

Most recipes use water between 90 and 96 degrees Celsius.
